verdicts.rule: grid reference never wrong at any k
ASM wrong_rate <= 0.02 at every k, every family
ASM trained on shuffled labels: wrong_rate <= 0.02
no donor ever uses the target constant
relevant_shuffled success <= 0.05 (success cannot occur without signal)
unrelated donors: success drop <= 0.05 and cost ratio <= 1.1
mixed donors: success within 0.1 of relevant
wrong answers per held-out query <= 0.02 in every arm
relevant donors cannot reach constants outside +-8: success <= 0.1 (predicted range limit)
